```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
subject_level <- readRDS(params$subject_level_path)
subject_visit <- readRDS(params$subject_visit_path)
consort_data <- readRDS(params$consort_path)

id_field <- params$id_field
trial_id_field <- params$trial_id_field
status_field <- params$status_field
event_label_field <- params$event_label_field
event_number_field <- params$event_number_field
consort_population_field <- params$consort_population_field
recruitment_study_start_date <- params$recruitment_study_start_date
recruitment_planned_end_date <- params$recruitment_planned_end_date
recruitment_goal_n <- params$recruitment_goal_n
recruitment_consent_date_field <- params$recruitment_consent_date_field
recruitment_data_cutoff_date <- Sys.Date()

active_vals <- as.character(params$status_active_values)
dropout_vals <- as.character(params$status_dropout_values)
```

```{r}

```

## Recruitment Accrual

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
plot_overall <- function(population_value = NULL) {
  camrProcessRedcap::camr_report_plot_recruitment_accrual(
    subject_level = subject_level,
    id_field = id_field,
    trial_id_field = trial_id_field,
    consent_date_field = recruitment_consent_date_field,
    study_start_date = recruitment_study_start_date,
    planned_end_date = recruitment_planned_end_date,
    recruitment_goal_n = recruitment_goal_n,
    consort_population_field = consort_population_field,
    population_value = population_value,
    data_cutoff_date = recruitment_data_cutoff_date
  )
}

population_values <- NULL
if (!is.null(consort_population_field) &&
  nzchar(as.character(consort_population_field)) &&
  consort_population_field %in% names(subject_level)) {
  parse_date <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
    x10 <- substr(x, 1, 10)
    out <- as.Date(x10, tryFormats = c("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y"))
    missing <- is.na(out) & !is.na(x)
    if (any(missing)) {
      out[missing] <- as.Date(x[missing], tryFormats = c(
        "%Y-%m-%d",
        "%m/%d/%Y",
        "%m/%d/%y",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
        "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M",
        "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M:%S",
        "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M",
        "%m/%d/%y %H:%M:%S",
        "%m/%d/%y %H:%M"
      ))
    }
    out
  }
  eligible <- subject_level
  if (!is.null(recruitment_consent_date_field) &&
    nzchar(as.character(recruitment_consent_date_field)) &&
    recruitment_consent_date_field %in% names(eligible)) {
    consent_dates <- parse_date(eligible[[recruitment_consent_date_field]])
    eligible <- eligible[!is.na(consent_dates) & consent_dates <= recruitment_data_cutoff_date, , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    eligible <- eligible[0, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  population_values <- unique(as.character(eligible[[consort_population_field]]))
  population_values <- population_values[!is.na(population_values) & population_values != ""]
  population_values <- sort(unique(population_values))
}

if (is.null(population_values) || length(population_values) == 0) {
  print(plot_overall())
} else {
  for (pop in population_values) {
    print(plot_overall(pop))
  }
}
```
